newsitem.title: ITALY: Credito aims to increase profitability.
newsitem.headline: Credito aims to increase profitability.

text.p: Italian banking group Credito Italiano confirmed at its shareholders meeting on Monday that its objective was to increase its profitability for 1997 and 1998.
The group's managing director Egidio Bruno said the bank's return on equity, currently at 4.7 percent, must increase to seven percent in 1997 and then to 11 percent in 1998.
The shareholders meeting, still underway, must approve the proposal to pay an ordinary dividend of 80 lire per ordinary share and 75 lire per savings share for 1996.
